name: worktrunk
post_install_message:
Worktrunk (`wt`) installed. Finish setup yourself (each step edits your shell/agent config, so it is not run for you):
  1. Shell integration (lets `wt switch` cd you into the worktree): wt config shell install
  2. Claude Code plugin (worktrunk skill + /wt-switch-create): wt config plugins claude install
     (or: claude plugin marketplace add max-sixty/worktrunk && claude plugin install worktrunk@worktrunk)
  3. Codex plugin (optional): wt config plugins codex install
Then restart your shell and Claude Code. Per-project setup (.config/wt.toml, .worktreeinclude): load the `worktree-dev-environment` skill.
description: Git worktree manager for parallel AI-agent work. `wt switch --create <branch>` makes a task worktree and runs the project's .config/wt.toml hooks (deps, git hooks, copied local files).
